desc.p: Creates an empty cache list for the user. Caches are added with services/lists/add_caches. The same rules apply as on the website's list form.

req.name: list_name
req.p: The list's name, at most 80 characters, unique among the user's lists (as on the website). A public list (list_status 2 or 3) needs a name of at least 10 characters.

opt.name: list_description
opt.p:
Plain text. The website keeps list descriptions as HTML, so the text is stored HTML-escaped, with its line breaks as
.

opt.name: list_status
opt.p: Who can see the list (the website's "visibility"):

ul.li: 3 - public, and shown in the listings of the caches on it.

opt.name: list_password
opt.p: Only for private lists: other users who know the password can open the list on the website. At most 80 characters. Like on the website, it is stored as given (not hashed), and it is dropped when the list becomes public.

opt.name: list_watch
opt.p: true or false: whether the user gets the website's notifications when caches on the list get new logs.

returns.p: A dictionary with list_id, the new list's id.
